```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
library(nlrFlow)
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
a <- nl_data("agronomy_growth")
# Fixed cultivar effects may act on nonlinear parameters; random effects preserve block/subject structure.
nl_mixed(biomass_Mg_ha~Asym/(1+exp(-k*(day-xmid))),a,fixed=list(Asym~cultivar,k~cultivar,xmid~1),random=Asym~1|block,start=c(18,1,1,.09,.01,.01,52))
nl_capabilities()
nl_teach("logistic")
```
